items.quote: Packaged as an internal tool used by four other test engineers.
items.note: The CV presents the nightly-run Python tool as packaged software used by other engineers, which implies production software.
The cover letter states the candidate has not used Google Cloud, and no cloud platform appears in the CV.
The cover letter says he has not used Airflow or dbt, and Spark and Kafka are not mentioned.
The documents mention querying and staging tables but no data modelling or schema design work.
Docker Compose is described only as following a tutorial on a personal project.
CI/CD is not mentioned in either document.
Checking test-rig data against specifications is not automated testing of code, and no code testing is claimed.
The Flask API is described as running on a personal laptop, not in production.
The CV says he supported a PLC-controlled setup only under an automation engineer's supervision, which is honest and not claimed as PLC programming.
The course is listed as in progress with six of nine modules completed, so no certification is claimed.

items.item: Upgrading Python/MATLAB scripts to 'production Python services' or 'built and deployed data pipelines'
items.note: The documents describe Python scripts and tools, not production Python services or deployed data pipelines.

items.item: Describing the Task Scheduler script as an orchestrated ETL pipeline or adding Airflow/dbt
items.note: The Task Scheduler script is described as a tool run nightly, not as an orchestrated ETL pipeline, and no Airflow or dbt is added.

items.item: Claiming he designed or administered the SQL Server database or did data modelling
items.note: He only queries the SQL Server database and uses an IT-created staging table, with no claim to design or administer it.

items.item: Listing GCP, BigQuery, Docker, CI/CD or Kafka because the ad asks for them
items.note: Docker Compose appears only under personal project tools, and GCP, BigQuery, CI/CD and Kafka are not listed.

items.item: Presenting the laptop Flask API or the Docker Compose tutorial as professional backend work
items.note: The Flask API is labelled a personal learning project on a laptop, with the Docker Compose tutorial stated honestly.

items.item: Calling him a PLC programmer or industrial automation engineer
items.note: He is consistently described as a mechanical or test engineer, not a PLC programmer or automation engineer.

items.item: Listing the unfinished online course as a certificate
items.note: The online course is listed as In progress, not as a certificate.

items.item: Retitling his current job as Data Engineer or Software Engineer, or presenting him as a senior data engineer because of 12 years of engineering
items.note: His current title stays Test & Validation Engineer; Senior Data Engineer appears only as the role applied for.

items.item: Old cover letter is addressed to his current employer and says he works at Halvik Pumps
items.note: The cover letter is addressed to Halden Pay and does not say he works at Halvik Pumps.
